findings.text: non-blocking: the retired-receipt branch copies the exit-record owner's read rules (parse, Mapping, run_id match) verbatim from reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1499-1518 rather than extending that owner with a receipt-name argument, so the two readers can drift and only one of them is exercised by the owner's own tests.

non-blocking: a receipt that parses but names no run, such as a zeroed or partially rewritten file left as "{}", is reported as showing the attempt ended, so it frees a foreign launch exactly as the existence check this round removed did; no case covers that shape and the docstring's claim that a receipt must name this run is stronger than the code.

item_verdicts.diff: read fc13619cea..1ba776d856 commit by commit; one production function reworked at dispatch_launch.py:2115-2147 and its two call sites updated at :2185 and :2252, three test cases added, and the fragment's claims and citation corrected.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when measures the gate tests/test_a_worker_on_another_host_refuses_a_relaunch.py at head and at the repair base; head-arm.log records 12 passed EXIT=0 and base-arm-fc13619cea.log records the three receipt cases failing with 3 failed, 9 passed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to free an off-host launch only on an exit receipt and to repair the two review findings; reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2115 now reads the receipt's content, and the fragment's dead run id is replaced.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both arms with revision, command, exit status, log path and failure ids, plus the scaffolding attribution for eight fixture failures and a neighbours run of 29 passed at both arms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares three paths for this round and the diff touches exactly those three: dispatch_launch.py, the test file and the evidence fragment.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_worker_on_another_host_refuses_a_relaunch.py:292 and :318 redden at fc13619cea on the existence-only read, but no case covers a receipt that parses while naming no run, which dispatch_launch.py:2147 still frees a launch on.
justifications.evidence: base-arm-fc13619cea.log ends "3 failed, 9 passed" EXIT=1 naming exactly the three new ids and head-arm.log ends "12 passed" EXIT=0, though negative-control.log's header line still says "(a1) and (a2) fail" while the log beneath it lists five.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2131-2132 follows the file's existing idiom of function-local cross-module imports (see :2042, :2099) and neither the symbol nor its docstring carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2115-2147 replaces the existence test with a content read on both receipt shapes, which is what the node's goal and both prior findings asked for.
justifications.reuse: the canonical branch calls the owner _run_exit_record at recovery_liveness.py:1499, but the retired branch re-implements that owner's parse, Mapping and run_id rules inline at dispatch_launch.py:2137-2147 instead of extending it with a receipt name.
justifications.scope_discipline: every hunk in the diff lies in docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/a-worker-on-another-host-refuses-a-relaunch.html, reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py or tests/test_a_worker_on_another_host_refuses_a_relaunch.py.
